---
title: "Fig. 2I - Pnut RNAi DAPI ploidy"
output: null
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(scales)
source("analysis_helpers.R")

data_file <- "../Data/Fig2I_pnutRNAi_DAPI_ploidy.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Fig2I_pnutRNAi_DAPI_ploidy.pdf"

ploidy <- read_analysis_csv(data_file)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2I: calculate mean DAPI intensity and fold change relative to control.

ploidy_summary <- ploidy %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(DAPI_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(DAPI_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(FoldChange = Mean / Mean[Genotype == "Control"])
ploidy_summary
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2I: test whether DAPI total intensity differs between control and pnut RNAi.

t.test(DAPI_total ~ Genotype, data = ploidy)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2I: plot DAPI total intensity distributions by genotype.

ggplot(ploidy, aes(x = Genotype, y = DAPI_total)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(colour = as.factor(Sample)),
    width = 0.15, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  stat_summary(
    fun.min = mean,
    fun = mean,
    fun.max = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  manuscript_theme() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-7)) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    labels = c("Control" = "Control", "Experimental" = "Pnut RNAi")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "1 x 10^7 A.U.", title = "DAPI total intensity")
ggsave(output_file, width = 2.5, height = 3, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```
